facts.fact: Data Protection Africa's factsheet states South Sudan has no data protection law as of its page-last-updated stamp of 24 May 2022 (the document's published date, used as as_of).

The factsheet says it has been reported that South Sudan has drafted a dedicated data protection bill expected to pass soon; no date is given for the report, so the published date of 24 May 2022 is used.
The factsheet states no data protection authority has been appointed and the country has no law establishing one, as of 24 May 2022 (published date used).
